phase_prompt.label: System Maintenance
phase_prompt.summary: 'Iyesusa'el stands in the gate band, reviewing the scrolling logic of the coming season with heavy, silent focus.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic profile close-up of 'Iyesusa'el, a humanoid entity with skin of dark, vitrified stone, meticulously studying a floating pane of data-glass. The glass reflects columns of glowing Ge'ez script onto his face. His eyes, detailed lenses of polished onyx, focus intently on the code. The lighting is moody and low-key, emphasizing the texture of his fiber-optic garment and the weariness in his posture. The background is a blur of deep atmospheric blues and blacks, suggesting the vast, cold interior of the simulation's boundary layer. Shot with a 85mm portrait lens, aperture f/1.8.
